classification.difficultyReason: Read class boundaries and heights, infer unlabelled boundaries from the horizontal scale, and multiply each varying class width by its height to obtain frequency.

inlines.text: Given the frequency histogram, find the corresponding frequency table.

spec.description: Four adjacent unfilled histogram bars, horizontal labels 8, 10, 12, 14, 16; vertical labels 1 through 5; arrowed axes and horizontal title X. No vertical-axis title or grid.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied histogram data are visible; recovered frequencies belong to answers.

inlines.text: Multiply each bar height by its class width, 2.
Frequency equals class width multiplied by bar height. Each class has width 2.

spec.description: Four adjacent unfilled histogram bars of unequal widths, horizontal labels 10, 13, 17; vertical labels 1, 2, 3; arrowed axes and horizontal title X. No vertical-axis title or grid.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied histogram data are visible; recovered frequencies belong to answers.

inlines.text: Multiply each bar height by its class width: 1, 2, 1 and 3 respectively.
Frequency equals class width multiplied by bar height. The class widths are 1, 2, 1 and 3.
